fullPassage: Eighteenth-century writers were almost all nobles: gentlemen-scholars who wrote for their own amusement and for the edification of others. They possessed the funds to support lives of leisure and the cultivation to write with style, and thus had immediate access to both financial support and content. By contrast, mid-nineteenth-century writers were more heterogeneous: although some were members of the social and economic elite, an increasing number earned their living by writing. Mid- nineteenth-century writers included not only belletrists but also hack journalists, technical writers, and bohemians; thus, their economic, social, and cultural resources varied considerably. Writers, regardless of age and possessions, traveled to different places to gather inspiration for their literary works. This means that writers became generally less likely to possess independent wealth or useful social connections and more likely to be restricted in their cultural resources to narrower areas of practical expertise.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Eighteenth-century writers were almost all nobles: gentlemen-scholars who wrote for their own amusement and for the edification of others. They possessed the funds to support lives of leisure and the cultivation to write with style, and thus had immediate access to both financial support and content.

(A) Writers, regardless of age and possessions, traveled to different places to gather inspiration for their literary works. This means that writers became generally less likely to possess independent wealth or useful social connections and more likely to be restricted in their cultural resources to narrower areas of practical expertise.

(B) By contrast, mid-nineteenth-century writers were more heterogeneous: although some were members of the social and economic elite, an increasing number earned their living by writing.

(C) Mid- nineteenth-century writers included not only belletrists but also hack journalists, technical writers, and bohemians; thus, their economic, social, and cultural resources varied considerably.

det.korean: 18세기 작가와 대조적으로 19세기 중반 작가의 다양성(B) → 그들의 구체적 구성원과 자원 다양성(C) → 작가들의 여행과 독립적 부의 감소(A).
det.analysis:
도입문은 18세기 작가들이 귀족이었고 재정적 지원과 콘텐츠에 즉각적으로 접근할 수 있었다고 설명한다.

✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): (B) 'By contrast'가 도입문의 18세기 작가와 19세기 중반 작가를 대조하며 연결 → (C) 'Mid-nineteenth-century writers included...'가 (B)에서 소개된 19세기 작가의 구성을 구체화하며 자원의 다양성 설명 → (A) 'Writers, regardless of...'가 일반화하며 독립적 부와 사회적 연결의 감소를 결론으로 제시

❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): (A)의 일반화가 맥락 없이 등장하며 'This means'가 가리킬 선행 내용 부족

❌ ② (A)-(C)-(B): 'By contrast'(B)가 맨 마지막에 오면 대조 대상이 5문장 전으로 너무 멀어짐

❌ ④ (C)-(A)-(B): 19세기 작가 구성원(C)이 소개 없이 등장하며 'By contrast'(B)가 결론 위치에서 부자연스러움
det.tip: By contrast가 대조 신호 → (B)가 도입 직후. included가 (B)의 heterogeneous를 구체화 → (C). This means가 (C)의 결론 → (A).
